vectors.flow: Owner release -> Integration registry -> Product route
positive: accepted owner record renders exact status and canonical route
negative: missing, stale, wrong-owner or invalid-source record never becomes public success

vectors.flow: Owner artifact -> Download admission -> Public download
positive: immutable URL, SHA-256, bytes, signing class, minimum OS and install evidence all required
negative: local, unsigned, simulator or unhashed artifacts remain hidden

vectors.flow: Monitor status -> Website status -> Public probe
positive: approved redacted status preserves source, version and as-of
negative: HTTP 200 alone never proves product or network health
